name: Veal Parmigiana
description: Crispy breaded veal cutlets topped with a homemade quick tomato sauce and melted mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1½ lb veal cutlets, ¼ inch thick
1 egg, beaten slightly with 2 to 3 tsp milk
¾ cup sifted dry bread crumbs
¾ cup fresh grated Parmesan cheese
½ to ¾ cup butter for frying
1 large can (16 oz) Italian crushed tomatoes
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare breading station: In one bowl, mix egg and milk. In another, combine bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Pound veal cutlets until thin, then coat in flour, dip in egg mixture, and finally coat with bread crumb mixture. Let sit for 15 minutes.
Melt butter in a frying pan and sauté veal over low heat until cooked through, flipping carefully.
Combine crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, onion, sugar, and salt in a pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer gently for 15 to 20 minutes to make the quick tomato sauce.
Place cooked veal in a baking pan, pour tomato sauce over the top, and sprinkle with shredded mozzarella cheese.
Bake in a preheated 400°F oven until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

keywords: veal parmesan, breaded veal, Italian-American, tomato sauce

_similar.name: Parmesan Chicken
_similar.description: A crispy Parmesan-crusted chicken dish baked with spaghetti sauce and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix Parmesan cheese with bread crumbs and set aside.
Mix eggs, salt, and pepper.
Dip boneless chicken breasts in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumb mixture.
Arrange coated chicken breasts in a baking dish.
Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Pour spaghetti sauce over the chicken and continue baking.
Before serving, sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes until browned.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in a bowl.
Spread 1½ cups of spaghetti sauce in the bottom of a 13x9x2 inch pan.
Arrange a layer of uncooked lasagna noodles on top of the sauce, overlapping slightly.
Sprinkle half of the mozzarella cheese and half of the cottage cheese mixture over the noodles.
Repeat with another layer of sauce, noodles, and the remaining cheeses.
Cover the top with sauce and cover tightly with heavy foil.
Set on a jelly roll pan and bake.

_similar.name: Pizza
_similar.description: A homemade pizza recipe with a yeast-based crust, topped with spaghetti sauce, various meats, and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Dissolve yeast in warm water with sugar. Let stand in a warm place for 10 minutes.
Measure flour and salt into a large bowl. Make a well and pour in the yeast mixture. Stir and add oil gradually, working the dough until thoroughly mixed.
Knead the dough, form into a ball, and let stand in a warm place for approximately 45 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Roll out the dough on a floured pastry board to an even thickness. Transfer to a pizza pan or cookie sheet.
Cover with spaghetti sauce, meats, mushrooms, and other toppings. Finish with mozzarella cheese.
Bake for approximately 20 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Let stand for 3 to 5 minutes before cutting and serving.

_similar.name: Baked Spaghetti and Meatballs
_similar.description: A hearty baked pasta dish featuring meatballs, spaghetti, and a rich tomato-based sauce topped with melted mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start boiling water for cooking spaghetti.
In a large bowl, mix ground beef, chopped onion, egg, Worcestershire sauce, and black pepper. Form into meatballs.
Fry the meatballs in a skillet until completely cooked, turning gently with tongs. Drain off excess fat.
Add spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, mushrooms, green pepper, and oregano to the skillet. Simmer for approximately 15 minutes.
Cook spaghetti until 'al dente', then rinse and drain.
Combine cooked spaghetti with sour cream.
Pour the spaghetti mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish. Sprinkle with half of the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the sauce and meatball mixture. Bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for an additional 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.
